evidence.origin: curated: Ensembl Compara release 116 protein gene trees; the deepest clade with an orthologue
evidence.strata: curated: Ensembl/NCBI taxonomy classification per species, placed on a fixed clade ladder
evidence.paralogues: curated: Ensembl Compara release 116 within-species and older paralogues
evidence.caveat: an origin is a lower bound on age: a gene lost in every sampled outgroup reads younger than it is
